# HeadGlance

Freelook head tracking via OpenTrack

[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/octocat/headglance)](https://github.com/octocat/headglance/releases/latest) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/headglance?logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/mod/headglance) [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/123456?logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/projects/123456) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/octocat/headglance)](https://github.com/octocat/headglance/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Installation

Download the latest release from the [releases page](https://github.com/octocat/headglance/releases/latest)
and drop the jar into your `mods` folder (Minecraft 1.21.1).

## Compatibility

Built for Minecraft 1.21.1.

| Mod | Type | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `neoforge` | required | `[21.1,)` |
| `minecraft` | required | `[1.21.1]` |
